metadata.title: 거짓의 왕관 — 2화 죽은 왕녀를 살려라
metadata.style_summary: 여성향 로판. drama_painterly(정제 세미리얼, 1화 동일). 단일 공간(그림의 방)의 정적 대화극 — 손/눈/소품/여백 인서트로 긴장 유지. 붉은 점 물증 비트 회수, 끝 훅: '나는 누구지? …이들은, 그걸 알고 온 걸까.'
metadata.image_generation_status: NOT_GENERATED — 이미지(패널)는 본 단계에서 생성하지 않음. 1화 시트·배경판·style_ref 전부 재사용(신규 생성 없음).

style_consistency.global_rule: Every panel is a final Korean webtoon image with integrated speech bubbles, narration boxes, and stylized SFX lettering. Keep consistent line weight, drama_painterly tonal shading, face proportions, lighting, and vertical-scroll composition across panels. 1화와 동일 룩.
fixed_style_traits: painterly comic/manhwa illustration with soft tonal shading and atmospheric depth
dramatic chiaroscuro built from LARGE readable value shapes
smooth low-frequency gradients allowed on cloth and background only
refined semi-real faces, MATTE-ish skin (no plastic/metallic skin sheen)
cool desaturated palette, SFX/lettering flat 2D ink with no 3D bevel or glow
forbidden_style_changes: scattered specular sparkle, glinting speckle highlights, or high-frequency shimmer on metal/silk/jewelry
blown-out light flash or a field of fine sparks/embers
lens bloom blowout, glow halo, rim-light halo
photographic / 3D background plates (background must be flat graphic large color planes with clean linework)
style_consistency.series_style: cool desaturated romance-fantasy palette — the abandoned palace portrait room in a colder regal hush (dusty light, cold slate and faded gilt); the slum flashback (cut 39) in cold rain-grey/ash-brown; clean medium-thin linework; soft painterly tonal shading; tense, ominous, melodramatic mood with refined faces
style_consistency.prompt_template: Korean vertical webtoon panel, drama_painterly render (refined semi-real cel — soft tonal shading + large readable value shapes + confident inking; cool desaturated palette). NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D, no glossy plastic skin, no bloom/glow halo, no depth-of-field blur. Flat graphic webtoon background (large simple color planes with clean linework, NOT a photo, NOT 3D). Follow the attached style reference for the look and the character sheets for identity. Render Korean text clean and correct, no garbled/fake letters, no watermark.
style_consistency.style_prompt_rule: Use WEBTOON_STYLE_REF consistently across all panels; only scene, composition, expression, and dialogue change.
style_consistency.prompt_note: 각 panel.prompt는 'STYLE_GUARD.'로 시작 → 빌드 시 위 prompt_template 원문으로 치환된다. 본 단계는 이미지 미생성.

character_consistency.global_rule: Every panel must reuse the same character identity from the 1화 character sheets. Identity = structure/color only; expression changes per beat. 2화는 신규 인물 없음.

(초상화) 세라 얼굴+가느다란 금관+크림 비단 드레스+은은한 미소, 새 인물 금지. (로드릭) 남색 재상복·뒤로 넘긴 잿빛 머리·slate 눈·clean-shaven. (카밀라) grey-green 눈·입가 흉터·낮게 묶은 짙은 머리.
